title: HR Director, US, Europe & Meta
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span class="acronym-highlight">OPSWAT</span>, a global leader in IT, <span class="acronym-highlight">OT</span>, and <span class="acronym-highlight">ICS</span> critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.</p></div><div class="row"> <div class="col-12 col-lg-8 col-xl-7 col-xxl-5"> </div> </div> <h3>A personal note from Andreea, Global Head of HR</h3> <p>I'm Andreea, Global Head of HR at OPSWAT. OPSWAT is also the kind of place where opportunities tend to find the people willing to take them on. Things move fast, there’s always something new to figure out, and you get a lot of space to make an impact. For me, HR works best when it can move at the pace of the business — close enough to understand what’s really going on and quick enough to make a difference. I don’t see that as a formula, though. I’d love to shape what it looks like together with someone who shares that mindset, but who will also bring their own perspective and challenge my thinking along the way. If this sounds like the kind of team and environment you’d enjoy being part of, I’d really love to hear from you.</p> <p> </p> <h3><strong><span data-contrast="none">The Position</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559738":280,"335559739":100,"335559740":264}"> </span></h3> <p><span data-contrast="auto">The Director, Human Resources for Europe, META (Middle East, Turkey, and Africa), and the US, is a Senior Leadership role reporting directly to our Global Head of HR (Human Resources) and acting as a trusted partner to leadership across all three regions.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":120,"335559740":264}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">This is not a maintenance role. It is a build-and-scale opportunity for someone who wants to shape how a global cybersecurity company grows, leads, and engages its people.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":120,"335559740":264}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">You will lead the HR function across 20+ countries, manage a regional team of HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition Business Partners and People Operations, and own the people strategy for a business expanding on every front. title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager (Paid Social)
description: The company Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are. That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed. We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive. The team The Direct Acquisition team at iwoca is responsible for acquiring customers profitably across paid and organic channels. Paid Social is one of our highest-growth channels; we've validated the opportunity, proven incrementality, and scaled from test budgets to six-figure monthly spend across Meta and TikTok. Now we need to build on those foundations and scale toward a 3x growth ambition across a multi-product offering that includes both flexi-loans and credit cards. You'll join a team that: Takes measurement seriously: We run conversion lift studies, work closely with data science on attribution, and make budget decisions based on predicted and incremental ROI, not vanity metrics. Cares deeply about creative: We believe the ad is the targeting, and we're building a creative engine that spans creator partnerships, UGC, and AI-assisted production. Is genuinely AI-native: We use AI tools daily for analysis, creative development, and workflow automation, and we expect you to do the same. The role Paid Social at iwoca is working; we've proven the channel's incremental value, scaled to six-figure monthly spend, and built the measurement infrastructure to back it up. But there's a lot more to go after with a credit card to bring to market, a creative engine to build, and a lot of room still to scale. The remit is broad - you'll scale the channel, bring our credit card to market and grow it aggressively alongside our core lending product. You'll invest heavily in creative - particularly video and influencer marketing - building ads that actually cut through in a category where most ads look the same. Key responsibilities include: Strategy & Campaign Architecture Own Paid Social as a channel: set the vision, define the road map, allocate budget, and report on performance to leadership. Bring our credit card product to market through paid social: build the campaign strategy, creative approach, and measurement framework for a major product launch. Architect full-funnel structures across Meta, TikTok and LinkedIn - awareness, prospecting, lead capture, re-targeting, and conversion - with clear success metrics, audience hand-offs, and frequency management at each stage. Manage multi-product overlap: flexi-loans, credit cards, and other products share audiences but serve different customer needs. Expand audience reach through content-led lead capture campaigns targeting out-of-market prospects to fuel top-of-funnel growth. Scale into new platforms where there's genuine opportunity; we’ve validated a significant opportunity on TikTok, but other platforms such as Linkedin and Youtube Shorts remain largely untapped. Creative Strategy & Production Develop creative that actually stands out: paid social in financial services is full of generic stock imagery and safe messaging. We want you to push beyond that, finding the concepts, formats, and creators that people actually notice. Make a significant investment in video and influencer marketing: build relationships with creators who can speak authentically about business finance, and develop a pipeline that delivers volume without it becoming generic. Build a testing framework that connects creative concepts to commercial outcomes Partner with the Brand team to make sure performance and brand creative reinforce each other rather than pulling in different directions. Measurement & Incrementality Design, run, and turn conversion lift studies and geo-lift tests into investment cases that prove incremental value and justify budget expansion. Partner with Data Science and the Acquitech team on attribution methodology, event architecture, and multi-step conversion tracking. Extend testing beyond ad platforms to landing page experiments and signup flow improvements to reduce drop-off between click and conversion. Leadership & Stakeholder Management Manage and develop a Performance Marketing Executive, coaching them on strategic thinking and commercial analysis while delegating clear operational ownership. Partner with Data Science, Engineering, Compliance, and Brand teams, while getting genuine strategic value from Meta and TikTok platform reps. The requirements Mechanically curious: You understand why platforms work the way they do, stay updated on algorithmic changes, and have an industry network for shared learning. High-initiative: You define experiments, draft business cases, and drive projects forward without waiting for explicit briefs. Analytically self-sufficient: You pull your own data, build your own performance views, and think in terms of CLTV, ROI, and marginal returns. AI-native: You already use AI tools meaningfully in your work - whether for creative analysis, reporting, workflow automation, or something we haven't thought of. Commercially minded: You care about profitable customer acquisition and lifetime value. What You Bring: Proven track record of scaling paid social budgets based on measured commercial performance. Deep campaign architecture expertise on Meta (bidding strategies, audience signals, and creative interaction). Experience with multi-product, multi-market and value-based bidding models. Strategic creative capability connecting concepts to commercial hypotheses. Nice to Have: B2B paid social experience (or strong analytical background in B2C). Experience managing or coaching junior team members. Fluency in measurement and incrementality (conversion lift studies, holdout methodologies, and incremental value). Hands-on experience with TikTok advertising at scale. Fintech or financial services background. The compensation £70,000 - £90,000 (bench marked regularly with quarterly performance reviews). The culture At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time. The offices We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work: Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks. Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions. The benefits Flexible working hours. Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership. A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses. A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents. 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave. A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years. Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support. 3% Pension contributions on total earnings. An employee equity incentive scheme. Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money. Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme. Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield. And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer: A learning and development budget for everyone. Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers. Access to learning platforms like Treehouse. Hybrid in Berlin or London We’re looking for a Growth Product Manager Own the systems that decide which German businesses iwoca reaches, and the journey they take from first click to submitted loan application. You’ll join a team that is still being built, with a data scientist in place and engineers being hired in parallel. A good fit if you like working from first principles, and would rather run an experiment than win an argument. The team The DE Acquisition Tech team builds the systems behind how German businesses discover iwoca and apply for funding: the models that decide which businesses to approach, the eligibility checks that tell a business early whether iwoca can help, and the signup flow itself. Product, analytics, data science and engineering sit in the same squad by design, so the team can go from hypothesis to shipped change without waiting on anyone else. The German marketing and sales teams depend on this work: the team’s models decide who they contact, and its journeys decide how many of those businesses convert. The team is being built right now. It currently includes a data scientist, and we’re hiring engineers in parallel – so you would join early enough to shape how the team operates. The role This role sits between iwoca’s German commercial teams – marketing, sales and commercial strategy – and the technical squad that builds for them. Reporting into the Head of Direct Acquisition, you will own acquisition and activation outcomes for the German market: finding the opportunities, defining the hypotheses, and working with engineering, data, marketing and sales to build, test and iterate. Strip friction out of the signup journey, so that applying for funding takes minutes rather than an afternoon. Investigate and resolve data quality issues – broken dashboards, misattributed traffic, unexplained volume changes – often at short notice. Give channel managers access to, and guidance on, the attribution logic behind their numbers. Keep the tracking and attribution systems trustworthy, so every decision downstream rests on numbers the team believes. Run the experiments that decide what ships Design, run and interpret A/B tests across messaging, targeting, eligibility checks and signup flows. Find opportunities from first principles, backed by data, customer research and funnel analysis. Define the priorities, roles and rituals of a team that is still being built. Turn the commercial strategy team’s goals into testable hypotheses and briefs the squad can act on. title: Back End Tech Lead - Funnel Platform
description: Back End Tech Lead - Funnel Platform Hybrid in London (UK) or Remote within the UK We’re hiring a Tech Lead for our Funnel Platform Team. You will lead the evolution of the shared code, frameworks, and integrations that power our services, build and improve business-critical systems, and shape the technical vision. Your customers are other iwoca engineers. The company Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are. That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed. We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive. The Team The Platform team owns approximately 10 shared services that the rest of iwoca engineering builds on top of - including the frameworks and integrations with external data providers (Experian, Equifax, TransUnion, Companies House etc) that underpin our credit decisions. This is not an SRE or DevOps team. Funnel Platform is code and framework focused - building and stewarding the shared services that the rest of engineering depends on. The team works hand-in-hand with other teams to build and deliver a shared vision for the future of the platform. The Role The Tech Lead role combines individual contribution, line management, and ownership of the platform roadmap. You will lead a team of developers focused on the shared services and frameworks that other iwoca engineering teams build on, driving technical strategy and translating our long-term vision into robust, maintainable systems. Your mission is "Making Change Easy" for the engineering teams that depend on you by owning shared services and being the trusted reviewer for contributions from partner teams, ending conflicts between maintenance and delivery through dedicated ownership. This is a hands-on technical leadership role where you will take full ownership of the team's roadmap and provide direct line management to its engineers. A balance of delivery, leadership, and influence: Act as a hands-on contributor and lead by example in quality, testing, and performance. Drive the technical strategy and execution for the Platform team, translating vision into well-designed, robust, and maintainable systems. Set direction without a PM - spot the problems worth solving, back them with data, and drive them to delivery. Architectural ownership and impact: Lead the development of shared frameworks and services that other engineering teams contribute to and build on. Collaborate with stakeholders in the commercial funnel teams to build a shared roadmap. Own the health of the shared services other teams depend on - spotting emerging issues, reviewing contributions from consuming teams, Shape architectural improvements to the shared services over time - measured on developer experience, service health, and reliability, not feature throughput Team leadership and management: Manage and mentor engineers, taking responsibility for their performance, coaching, and career development. Define and champion engineering best practices within your team and across the wider engineering group. The requirements Essential: Experience developing and owning shared back end services that other engineering teams contribute to and depend on - being the trusted reviewer for their contributions and shaping how they build on top of your work. Experience building and shaping distributed systems in complex business domains. Advanced proficiency in software development. Confidence to work closely with partners from other disciplines to challenge assumptions and discover underlying problems. Demonstrable leadership skills: you have mentored juniors and inspired teams to deliver cross-functional projects. You can balance hands-on coding with strategic planning. You use AI (like Cursor, Claude Code or similar) in your daily flow—whether for work or for fun. You use it to blast through boilerplate and research, so you can focus on the hard parts: complex architecture, rigour, and high-stakes decision-making. Bonus: A strong numerical or technical background, ideally with a degree in physics, engineering, maths, computer science or a related field. Experience with Python, Django, or PostgreSQL. Familiarity with data analytics or machine learning processes. Experience with complex data architectures, including event-sourced data models. Gap Assurance: Evaluate the mapping of financial crime typologies against active transaction monitoring coverage to independently identify and escalate potential tracking gaps to senior management. 2. Independent Compliance Challenge & Assurance Framework Segmentation & Calibration Challenge: Provide independent, 2LoD challenge to data-driven customer segmentation methodologies executed by the First Line (1LoD), verifying alignment with merchant risk profiles. Compliance Oversight in Tuning & Optimization: Review and evaluate the methodologies, statistical testing parameters, and documentation for periodic "Below-the-Line" (BTL) and "Above-the-Line" (ATL) testing performed by the First Line to ensure robust governance. Residual Risk Opining: Formulate independent compliance opinions regarding residual risk acceptance, providing formal advisory input to governance forums and the Global MLROs. 3. Governance, Risk, & Reporting Model Risk Governance: Participate in the compliance review of TM systems and model validation exercises, independently assessing the transparency, logic, and regulatory defensibility of detection models against applicable guidance (e.g., FCA guidance on model risk management). Strategic Alignment: Provide regulatory compliance support to the Head of TM to assist in aligning roadmap initiatives with the compliance maturity framework. Governance & Escalation Paths: Support the enhancement of the TM compliance governance framework to facilitate the structured, independent escalation of risk metrics to senior management. Metrics & KRI Oversight: Assist in the production of 2LoD Management Information (MI) and Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) to track the effectiveness of the compliance oversight posture for the Head of TM and Global MLRO. 3. Data Integrity & Alert Lifecycle Assurance Data Lineage Assurance: Review documentation regarding data lineage, integrity, and completeness for feeds ingested into the monitoring architecture to ensure compliance with regulatory standards. Lifecycle Evaluation: Evaluate the end-to-end alert workflow governance, risk scoring frameworks, and prioritization mechanics to ensure high-risk alerts adhere to compliant escalation paths. Feedback Loops: Analyze high-level alert outcomes and disposition trends to provide compliance feedback loops to technical teams, supporting iterative improvements in the quality of Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs). Mentorship: Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical staff, and help improve the team's engineering standards. Hands-on experience administering IAM platforms (e.g. Okta, GoogleWorkspace). Deep hands-on experience with GoogleWorkspace products Practical hands-on experience with Cloud platforms (e.g AWS, GCP) Relevant and practical experience with Infrastructure-as-code (e.g Terraform) Experience implementing modern authentication standards (FIDO2, WebAuthn, SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect). Practical experience securing macOS, Windows and Linux endpoints using MDM and EDR/XDR tooling. Experience operating SIEM and/or SOAR platforms and tuning detection logic. Experience with vulnerability management and patch governance. Ability to write production-quality automation scripts. Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional technical initiatives. Desirable Skills Experience with SASE or Zero Trust Network Access platforms. Hands on experience deploying applications into K8 and Docker environments Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and SaaS security governance. Advanced detection engineering or SOAR playbook development. Experience supporting ISO 27001 or SOC 2 audits. Relevant certifications (e.g. CISSP, CISM, GIAC). title: Senior Data Scientist - Business Operations
description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. About Deliveroo Our mission is to transform the way people shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of one of the most rapidly expanding industries in the world: a complex, always-on, three-sided marketplace that impacts millions of people every day. Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. The Team BizOps is the team that keeps its finger on the pulse of business performance: continuously, rigorously, and across multiple dimensions at once. We turn raw operational and financial data into actionable intelligence, surfacing what is happening, why it is happening, and what to expect next , for the operators, executives, and functional teams who run the business day to day. We are not a reporting function that produces outputs on request. We work continuously, proactively watching, delivering, and questioning whether the signal is real, acting as "first responders" to surprising deviations from expectation and using what we learn to drive faster, better decision-making for the business at large. Our work spans the full stack of analytics: from the warehouse models that make metrics trustworthy, to the monitoring systems that catch problems early, to the reports and dashboards that make performance visible, to the deep-dive investigations that explain what the numbers mean and what we should do about it. We anchor our analysis to the right reference points: how performance compares to plan, to prior periods, and to what we'd expect, and we bring causal rigour when the business needs to know whether an action actually worked. The culture within the team is informal, fast-paced and entrepreneurial. Given the growth of the business and the level of senior stakeholder exposure, progression in the team can be fast. The Role Deliveroo is hiring a Senior Data Scientist to join BizOps, based in our London HQ (hybrid, minimum three days per week in the office). This role is largely project-based: starting from a strategic or performance question, you'll combine data, business context, and structured problem-solving to provide the insights that drive decision-making at a global level with senior stakeholders. You will own delivery end-to-end, from the messy, ambiguous question to a rigorous, trustworthy, and actionable answer. You'll be equally comfortable building the systems that make performance visible and going deep on the investigations that explain it. One week you might diagnose why a key market has moved away from plan; the next, identify the drivers behind a change in customer or operational performance; the next, build monitoring that helps teams spot and understand emerging issues earlier. Success in this role requires building effective working relationships across Deliveroo, particularly with international markets, as well as the Data Science, Operations, Commercial, and Finance teams. What You'll Be Doing Answer the questions that matter, continuously. Maintain a rigorous view on business performance: Are we on track against our goals? What's changed? How does this compare with what we expected? What should we expect next? Then go further: Why is it happening, what matters most, and what should we do about it?" Own delivery end-to-end. Independently identify, define, and deliver impactful work aligned with business goals, operating with minimal guidance to ship fast, high-quality solutions. Navigate ambiguity. Deconstruct broad, ambiguous problem spaces into structured analytical roadmaps, and understand how your work intersects with adjacent systems and teams. Build for scale, not one-offs. Build the pipelines, models, dashboards, monitoring, and investigative tooling that make performance visible and reliable. Automate wherever possible; redoing analyses by hand is slow and error-prone. Measure impact with discipline. Design measurement strategies from simple A/B tests to quasi-experimental designs (synthetic control, difference-in-differences, event studies) when trials aren't feasible, always with conservative, assumption-explicit language. Be a first responder. Surface deviations before they become escalations, and be just as willing to give the confident "this is noise, no action needed" as the alarm. Communicate to influence. Translate complex findings into clear, simple, actionable recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences that shape roadmaps and decisions. Raise the bar. Contribute to the broader Analytics community, improve shared approaches and best practices, and help build data literacy across the business. title: Labour AI Specialist
description: About Sona Running a frontline business is an operational puzzle most software has never touched. Shift-by-shift labour costs, compliance that changes by region and by role, and margins thin enough that a badly built rota can sink a quarter. It's a harder problem than most white-collar SaaS, and yet frontline sectors employ 80% of the global workforce and have received about 1% of the last decade's software investment. We think that's because the problem needed AI, not just better software, before it was solvable. Frontline organisations sit on enormous amounts of operational data. Used properly, that data lets agents take on real parts of running the business rather than just reporting on it. That's what we're building at Sona, and it's early enough that the systems you build now will still be foundational in three years. We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here . About the Role Sona's Labour AI team builds the forecasting, rules and scheduling tools that help hospitality and retail businesses get staffing right. Getting the tooling built is one problem. Getting it to actually work for a specific site, with its own trading patterns, staff and quirks, is another. That's what this role owns; working directly with customers to turn Sona's forecasting and scheduling tools into labour models that actually get used on site. You'll derive labour rules from real trading data, spend time on site with customer teams to learn how the business actually runs, and build the trust with site managers that makes a new workload model stick. You'll present the impact and ROI of that work to customer executives and general managers, and act as the subject matter expert for labour optimisation in sales conversations. You'll also be the person site managers trust enough to change how they staff, and the person customer executives and General Managers trust enough to back the changes you're proposing. That's an influence job as much as an analytical one. You'll report back to customer leadership on the impact, in numbers they can take to their own board. There's no fixed playbook here. You'll adapt the same underlying labour model across different business types, from QSR to premium dining to retail. You understand how the business runs day to day, not just how to analyse it from the outside Confident presenting to and winning buy-in from customer executives, general managers and boards, and comfortable holding your own with competing agendas in the room Comfortable with technology and confident picking up new tools quickly, including using AI tools in your own workflow Able to look into the data yourself and make decisions from what you find Comfortable operating without a fixed playbook Excited about using AI in your day-to-day work to 10x your output Bonus: a retail or workforce-management background where the underlying concepts transfer to hospitality Bonus: a commercial finance background with genuine credibility in front of operators Benefits Salary: £85,000 - £100,000 Hybrid working, 2+ days/week in our London office (Soho), with customer-facing travel Share options 35 days annual leave (25 days standard plus 10 flexible public holiday days) Extra day of leave for every year of service Pension contributions matched up to 5% Comprehensive health insurance Enhanced parental leave & pay Salary sacrifice childcare scheme (Workplace Nursery) Annual all expenses paid team retreats The latest Macbook and equipment budget for your home office Professional development budget Unlimited free books Note: this represents a typical benefits package for a UK-based, full-time employee. description: <p>Coding agents are only as good as the context they're given. Most explore a repository like a new hire on day one – grepping, opening files, guessing. JetBrains Context replaces that with actual knowledge of your whole codebase and resources, served to any agent that asks. If you want to own the layer that decides what an agent knows before it writes a single line, this is for you.</p> <h2><strong>About JetBrains</strong></h2> <p>We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <p>As agents get better at searching for themselves, what is the durable value of a managed retrieval layer? We need someone with an opinionated answer to own JetBrains Context as a product – defining what it is for, who it is for, how we measure success, and where it goes next.</p> <p>This is a hands-on role where you'll manage the product from a terminal and agent session rather than slides. You'll bridge the technical core and cross-functional teams: collaborating closely with engineering and ML teams on indexing pipelines and retrieval quality, working with Air, IDE, and Junie teams on integrations, and partnering with marketing, developer advocacy, sales, and customer success on positioning and adoption. You'll take full ownership of defining problem statements, setting explicit trade-offs, and balancing cost, latency, and freshness across the platform.</p> <p>Day to day, you will:</p> <ul> <li>Build and maintain a deep working understanding of chunking, embeddings, index freshness, retrieval, reranking, and agent-facing surfaces.</li> <li>Define and defend an opinionated vision for the product's evolution, including explicit target audiences, use cases, and key success metrics.</li> <li>Translate product strategy into actionable problem statements, priorities, plans, and milestones with an explicit definition of “done”.</li> <li>Communicate product direction clearly to engineering, leadership, cross-functional stakeholders, customers, and prospects.</li> <li>Analyze competing context and code-search products through direct use to establish clear differentiators and identify gaps.</li> <li>Define core operational and product metrics – index freshness, retrieval quality, agent task outcomes, adoption, retention, and unit economics – to guide decision-making.</li> <li>Represent the product externally by sharing roadmaps, publishing updates, speaking to developer audiences, and gathering community feedback.</li> <li>Partner with ML teams on model evaluation and platform teams on service scale, reliability, and cost.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>A well-argued point of view on where AI-first development is going and what agents genuinely need from a context layer.</li> <li>Comfort with technical depth across embeddings, retrieval quality, sub-agents, tool-calling, indexing costs, and API design.</li> <li>The habit of using the product you build daily alongside competitors' tools.</li> <li>Communication that adapts to different audiences, from staff engineers and enterprise architects to conference attendees.</li> <li>A data-informed approach that combines telemetry, evaluation results, customer conversations, and market signals.</li> <li>Comfort with ambiguity and a preference for defining a new category over copying an existing one.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll need</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Proven experience owning a complex developer, platform, or infrastructure product end to end, including strategy and roadmap.</li> <li>Hands-on familiarity with modern AI coding tools and agent workflows.</li> <li>The technical capability to work directly with engineering on retrieval behavior, APIs, data models, and integration surfaces.</li> <li>The ability to define metrics for quality-sensitive products and build evaluation habits that maintain product standards.</li> <li>Experience communicating a product externally through written content, talks, or community engagement.</li> <li>Practical experience with search, retrieval, RAG, developer search, or static analysis at scale is a plus.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What success looks like</strong></h2> <p>Within your first months, you'll form and share a clear thesis for what JetBrains Context is and is not – one the engineering team recognizes as theirs and leadership can invest in. You'll establish a metrics story that distinguishes real retrieval quality from vanity usage, a roadmap with clear trade-offs, and a documented evaluation of serious competitors.</p> <p>Longer term, success means JetBrains Context becomes a deliberate choice for developers and organizations, agents get measurably better answers because it exists, enterprises adopt it for its governance and scale, and the market clearly understands its unique value because you've communicated it effectively.</p> <p><strong><br><br>Why join JetBrains? </strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong base salary. title: Paid Social Director (FTC)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>2581 - Paid Social Director (FTC) - GCS</strong></p> <p><strong>Role Summary and Impact</strong></p> <p>Audible is Wavemaker Worldwide’s largest client and one of the world’s favourite platforms for audio content, from podcasts to audio books to Audible Originals. Audible have ambitious growth targets that we will help them achieve through both branding and performance campaigns across four major markets: France, Italy, Germany and Spain giving the applicate an opportunity to work across market and understand how different markets behaviour and respond to media. </p> <p>Role Context: </p> <p>We are looking for a paid social specialist to continue their career as Account Director. This person will assume day-to-day responsibility for the paid social planning, activation and general output of a busy client account (/accounts). They will help oversee a team of more junior staff responsible for the everyday running of the account and ensure our strategic audience first approach to performance to made reality. This person will also be required to develop strong relationships with clients, suppliers, and our counterparts in the US, Germany and APAC region to become a trusted voice for all things paid social. As such the ideal candidate is someone with extensive knowledge of paid advertising across all of the key social channels (Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, Snap, TikTok etc) who has a deep understanding of best approaches and practices to performance both direct to site and app downloads (MAI – app installs). </p> <p>Key Responsibilities: </p> <p>Account Directors are charged with responsibility for the day-to-day paid social output of one (or more) client accounts, with several key areas of focus. These include: </p> <p>Campaign Management </p> <ul> <li>    Overseeing the production of comprehensive paid social media plans (+ supporting material) that align with client’s objectives and KPIs. Able to clearly articulate the rationale for proposed campaign tactics (channels, budget, audience, formats etc.) and present these back, both to internal and external stakeholders. </li> <li>    Managing both the paid social brand and performance campaigns (web sign ups and Monthly app installs), with the ability to manage a set of highly knowledgeable Social clients.  </li> <li>    Overseeing a hybrid team (made up of both local and Global Hub employees) responsible for the end-to-end setup of paid social campaigns across all the relevant social platforms. </li> <li>    Comfortable troubleshooting and helping train junior team members to use advanced features such as bid rules and 3rd party optimisation/creative/measurement tools. </li> <li>    Responsible for maintaining the standard of regular quality assurance (QA) checks undertaken by those working on the account to ensure campaigns are set up to defined best practice standards (and helping to evolve these best-practices as necessary). </li> <li>    Working with team to ensure the standard and accuracy of weekly/monthly campaign performance reports. Leading client calls on a regular basis and supporting the wider team to present results as necessary. </li> <li>    Ensuring all performance commentary delivers valuable insight and recommendations to clients. Working with the team to identify trends and recommend actions on-platform to capitalise/mitigate these trends as necessary.  </li> <li>    Ensuring the standard of end-of-campaign reporting and quarterly/annual reviews. Leading standalone research projects as required by the client. </li> </ul> <p>Client & Partner Management  </p> <ul> <li>    Responsible for delivering on the over-arching paid social strategy across the account(s) and ensuring this ties in with the wider digital and comms strategy. </li> <li>    Become thought leaders on Paid social for audible the 4 markets, DE, FR, IT, ES. Driving change and advanced. </li> <li>    Acting as a key social point-of-contact for your client(s) ensuring their continuing confidence in the quality of the team and agency’s social output. </li> <li>    Demonstrating a deep understanding of the media and technology developments that influence your client’s business.  </li> <li>    Able to identify opportunities to test and innovate in the paid social space, presenting these opportunities to stakeholders and securing client backing. </li> <li>    Managing internal and external stakeholders to ensure multiple projects can be delivered simultaneously and to the required standard. </li> <li>    Building and maintaining relationships with the key media partners including Meta, X, Snap, TikTok, Pinterest and others. </li> </ul> <p>People Management  </p> <ul> <li>    Ensuring the effective management of both the local team (de, fr, it, es) and Global Hub employees, ensuring workloads are sufficiently monitored & prioritised to ensure deadlines are met. </li> <li>    Establish and continue to foster relationships with Wavemaker offices across the globe. US, EU, APAC. </li> <li>    Working your Account Manager and the team leadership to help train and develop entry level team members. Leading by example to motivate and encourage all those with less experience on the team. </li> <li>    Communicate clearly and in a timely manner with internal and external stakeholders as required across email, chat, video and in-person. Leading presentations where necessary. </li> <li>    Attend and lead regular internal meetings and training sessions in order to actively contribute to a collaborative and friendly paid social community. </li> <li>    Leading the recruitment process for your immediate team and working with the head of department to assist with wider team recruitment as needed. This will involve leading interviews, making staffing decisions and acting as an ambassador for the team to potential candidates. </li> </ul> <p>Operational Excellence </p> <ul> <li>    Identify opportunities to test and innovate in the paid social space. Presenting these opportunities to stakeholders and securing client backing. Developing these into initiatives that can be used to further evolve the standard & efficiency of paid social buying across the wider team. </li> <li>    Developing tailored testing/learning agendas for clients that drive clear and actionable insight on each social platform. </li> <li>    Working closely with planning team + other channel specialists to ensure paid social activity compliments and enhances the wider marketing mix.  </li> <li>    Collaborating on thought-leadership pieces and POVs for the agency and GMS social community. </li> <li>    Responsible for the accurate and effective management of agency finance processes. Ensuring the immediate team fulfil the mandatory finance process in a timely and accurate manner to ensure prompt payment/invoicing and minimise finance queries. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>    Experience in performance media with a good level of expertise across paid social </li> <li>    Strong understanding of how paid social works within the performance and digital ecosystem. </li> <li>    Working knowledge of best practices within social. </li> <li>    Understand of mobile app download campaigns within social platforms. </li> <li>    Experience in performance social campaigns. </li> <li>    Experience setting Social brand and performance KPIs for clients. </li> <li>    Working knowledge of key tracking solutions. </li> <li>    Proven people management and leadership qualities. </li> <li>    Ability to manage upwards as well as downwards. </li> <li>    Possesses initiative and demonstrates resourcefulness. </li> <li>    All academic backgrounds will be considered – qualifications in maths, data, media of interest. </li> <li>    Professional digital media/advertising qualifications will be of an advantage. </li> <li>    Excellent organisational and communication skills. </li> <li>    Hands-on experience in planning, buying and optimising across all channels is useful. </li> </ul> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none">Life at WPP Media & Benefits</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-contrast="none">Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-contrast="none">Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-contrast="none">Championing Growth and Development</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-contrast="none">for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">We</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-contrast="none">Create an Open environment</span><span data-contrast="none"> </span><span data-contrast="none">built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. title: Commerce Account Director
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>3071 - Commerce Account Director</strong></p> <p><strong>About Wavemaker: A leading WPP Media brand</strong></p> <p>Grounded in analytics & insights and powered by data & technology, we believe in the power of media and creative to drive breakthroughs for the world’s best brands. We help clients understand the modern marketing paradox and discover the breakthroughs brands need to win with their consumers. We are designed for the new communications economy — built on data & technology, built for people & algorithms, built around diverse schools of thought, built to test & learn at scale, and, crucially, built to evolve.</p> <p><strong>Role Summary and impact</strong></p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Account Leadership & Delivery<br></strong>Lead the end-to-end output of the team across client-facing work and operational delivery. Ensure consistently high standards, with strong adherence to processes, controls, and best practices.</li> <li><strong>Strategic Planning & Business Understanding<br></strong>Develop a deep understanding of the client’s business, objectives, and KPIs. Apply this to shape effective, insight-led retail media strategies that drive measurable outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Retail Media Platform Expertise (Amazon, Citrus, Criteo)<br></strong>Demonstrate strong experience working across key retail media platforms including Amazon, CitrusAd, and Criteo. Apply platform expertise to guide planning, optimisation, and performance, ensuring best-in-class execution across search and display channels.</li> <li><strong>Tesco Retail Media SME Leadership<br></strong>Act as the subject matter expert for Tesco retail media, overseeing full-funnel activity and ensuring a cohesive approach from awareness through to conversion. Provide strategic guidance to both internal teams and clients on Tesco capabilities, opportunities, and best practices.</li> <li><strong>Innovation & Proactive Thinking<br></strong>Stay informed on industry trends, platform developments, and new product releases. Proactively identify and introduce opportunities to enhance client performance and maintain a competitive edge.</li> <li><strong>Client & Partner Relationship Management<br></strong>Build and maintain strong relationships with key client stakeholders and media partners. Act as a trusted point of contact, confidently contributing insights and recommendations beyond immediate scope.</li> <li><strong>Team Leadership & Development<br></strong>Support and develop a high-performing team, fostering a collaborative and accountable working environment. Take an active role in coaching, performance management, and career progression.</li> <li><strong>Communication Leadership<br></strong>Lead day-to-day communications across clients, partners, and internal stakeholders, ensuring clear alignment and effective delivery. Engage senior leadership when required.</li> <li><strong>Operational Excellence & Process Improvement<br></strong>Continuously identify opportunities to improve efficiency through better processes, automation, and adoption of tools and technology.</li> <li><strong>Financial & Process Ownership<br></strong>Oversee activation-related financial processes, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely delivery across all campaigns.</li> <li><strong>Measurement & Performance<br></strong>Maintain a strong understanding of measurement frameworks and partner capabilities. Use this knowledge to guide optimisation strategies and performance discussions with clients.</li> <li><strong>Workshops & Strategic Contribution<br></strong>Lead and contribute to client workshops and planning sessions, bringing structured thinking, insight, and strategic direction.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Team Collaboration<br></strong>Work closely with cross-functional teams (including GOC) to ensure seamless integration and consistent, high-quality execution across all workstreams.</li> <li><strong>Retail Media Integration<br></strong>Play a key role in embedding retail media within broader client strategies, identifying opportunities to connect activity across the wider marketing mix, including audience planning in systems such as Sphere and Nectar 360.</li> <li><strong>Partner & Product Development<br></strong>Support the development and testing of commerce products and solutions in collaboration with partners such as Skai, ensuring continued innovation and relevance.</li> <li><strong>Personal Development<br></strong>Set clear objectives with your line manager and demonstrate ongoing growth in leadership, strategic thinking, and client impact.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong> </p> <p>At WPP Media, our culture and people are at the heart of everything we do. In this role, it is essential to embody WPP and WPP Media’s core values:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Be Extraordinary</strong> by leading collectively to inspire transformational creativity.</li> <li><strong>Create an Open Environment</strong> by balancing people and client needs, cultivating trust and collaboration.</li> <li><strong>Lead Optimistically</strong> by championing growth and development to drive progress across the business.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <ul> <li>Strong experience in <strong>eCommerce and retail media</strong>, including campaign set-up, management, optimisation, and reporting across both media owner and technology vendor platforms.</li> <li>Excellent understanding of the <strong>strategic and tactical application of retail media and digital marketing</strong>, with the ability to translate this into effective client solutions.</li> <li>Proven hands-on experience across key platforms, including <strong>Amazon, Criteo, and CitrusAd</strong>, with a solid understanding of the wider UK retail landscape (e.g. Tesco, Sainsbury’s, ASDA, Morrisons, Ocado) and quick commerce partners (e.g. Deliveroo, Uber Eats).</li> <li>Experience working with <strong>bid management platforms</strong> such as Skai and/or Pacvue.</li> <li>Experience with planning and activation across search/sponsored product and DSP.</li> <li>Experience with AMC for audience and insight a bonus.</li> <li>Demonstrated <strong>project management and team leadership experience</strong>, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and deliver against deadlines.</li> <li>Strong <strong>stakeholder management skills</strong>, with experience coordinating across clients, internal teams, and external partners.</li> <li>High level of <strong>data literacy</strong>, with the ability to interpret performance data and translate insights into clear strategic recommendations.</li> <li>Strong <strong>attention to detail</strong>, ensuring accuracy and quality across all outputs.</li> <li>Confident <strong>communication and storytelling skills</strong>, able to present ideas and strategies clearly and persuasively to a range of stakeholders.</li> <li>Effective <strong>team management capabilities</strong>, including workload prioritisation, clear communication, and supporting team development.</li> <li>A proactive, solutions-focused mindset with the ability to remain <strong>calm under pressure</strong> and navigate complex or fast-paced environments.</li> <li>A genuine drive to <strong>elevate work beyond the expected</strong>, bringing energy, curiosity, and continuous improvement to the role.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media & Benefits</strong> </p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.  </p> <p>We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.  </p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.  </p> <p><em>Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location</em> </p> <p>Please read our Privacy Notice (<a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy">https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy)</a> for more information on how we process the information you provide. </p> <p> </p> <p>While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.  </p> <p>#LI-Promoted </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.co

title: Associate Director, Planning
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>3188 - Associate Director, Planning - UK</strong></p> <p><strong>Role Summary and Impact</strong></p> <p>We are recruiting for an Account Director who is an exceptional and driven media planner, to join our Connections Planning team.</p> <p>For bp you will work as part of the wider WPP inter-agency team, ‘Team Energy’, primarily across Retail, Fuel, Loyalty campaigns, as well as their new and exciting electric charging offering – bp Pulse. Regarding the planning work specifically, the bp account offers the opportunity to build internal and external agency exposure and further establish project management skills through management of multiple campaigns across multiple business units.</p> <p>We foster a highly collaborative environment with brilliant, forward-thinking clients who are not only engaged but genuinely enthusiastic about pushing boundaries. This partnership allows us to deliver truly exciting, market-leading work that sets industry benchmarks and drives significant impact.</p> <p>Expect a role that is highly strategic, requiring deep analytical thinking, a keen commercial eye, and a flair for innovative solutions. We are consistently exploring new technologies, channels, and audience engagement models, ensuring your work remains at the cutting edge. Innovation is not just encouraged, it's expected.</p> <p>Crucially, you'll have seamless access to a rich tapestry of agency expertise. You'll collaborate daily with our specialist teams in data science, advanced measurement & analytics, brand strategy, and consumer insights. This integrated approach empowers you to craft media plans that are not only creative and impactful but also deeply informed, measurable, and strategically sound.</p> <p><strong><u>About the role</u></strong></p> <p>You will be expected to demonstrate experience and knowledge in -</p> <ul> <li>Knowing the tools and means to build and target audiences in addressable and non-addressable media to validate the media approach ensuring that the defined audience can be reached at the scale required</li> <li>Designing an approach that outlines how and where we will connect with defined audiences – especially hard to reach / low media engagement audiences – in media for brand and performance campaigns.</li> <li>Connecting the dots between the data we, the client, media owners and other internal teams hold to plan most effectively.</li> <li>Designing the connections ecosystem & plan, working closely and collaboratively with channel specialists and wider agency teams from a paid, owned and earned perspective</li> <li>Day to day management of campaigns and annual planning as a key liaison between clients and channel specialists</li> <li>Designing measurement & testing framework to inform as well as measure and optimise the campaigns when live</li> <li>Management of others to develop their skills</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <p>At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It’s what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP & WPP Media’s shared core values:</p> <ul> <li>Be <strong>Extraordinary</strong> by <em>Leading Collectively</em> to <em>Inspire transformational Creativity.</em></li> <li>Create an <strong>Open</strong> environment by<em> Balancing People and Client Experiences</em> by <em>Cultivating Trust</em>.</li> <li>Lead <strong>Optimistically</strong> by <em>Championing Growth</em> <em>and Development</em> to <em>Mobilize the Enterprise</em>.</li> <li>You show a breadth of understanding of all media channels and can confidently discuss the role they play within a comms strategy</li> <li>Have an interest in both brand and performance campaigns with some knowledge of ecommerce</li> <li>You are a tool ‘wizard’...well not quite but excellent knowledge of audience research and planning tools (e.g. TGI & Touchpoints) is a must and awareness of / familiarity with alternative sources (such as media owner tools & data) is a plus</li> <li>Ability to draw clear insights and implications for media (i.e. connecting the outputs of different insight systems successfully)</li> <li>Demonstrate a passion for media and understanding of what makes a great media campaign, tangibly showcasing excellence in planning craft.</li> <li>Take responsibility for the upfront work that needs to happen in order to deliver a great, clear and concise universal brief to the specialist teams that hits the clients' brief on the head</li> <li>You care about proving your campaigns work! How? By being able to create a holistic measurement framework relevant for your brand and applicable to every campaign that is digestible (setting KPI’s methods I.e., which tool/system, necessary tracking) and plan for adaptation/optimisation</li> <li>You are confident in presenting with passion and conviction, managing senior client relationships, running all agency team sessions and collaboratively leading client projects and tackling challenging conversations.</li> <li>You are excited to work as part of a team; immediate, wider department and specialists as required. Leading by example though presence and contribution. Taking the responsibility for working in a collaborative, inclusive way</li> <li>You demonstrate excellent attention to detail and accuracy in output and meeting deadlines. As well as strong organization to meet client expectations, manage workflow for self and junior team members.</li> <li>Demonstrate a proactive desire to continually improve own knowledge and wider skill set</li> <li>You are open minded, flexible and have a challenger mindset.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media & Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.  </p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.<br><br>We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.</p> <p><em>Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location</em></p> <p>Please read our Privacy Notice (<a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy">https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy)</a> for more information on how we process the information you provide.</p> <p>While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted. </p> <p>#LI-Promoted</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"> <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":276}"> </span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Associate Director, Creative Strategy – Sports & Entertainment
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>3135 - Associate Director, Creative Strategy – Sports & Entertainment - UK</strong></p> <p><strong>Role Summary and Impact</strong></p> <p>WPP Media is the UK’s biggest media agency network. More clients choose to work with us than anyone else in the UK. This success is delivered via a clear, client centric vision – <em>to be the most trusted growth partner for brands.</em></p> <p>WPP Media: Sports & Entertainment is our dedicated practice focused on the development of brand partnerships, sponsorships, branded entertainment and socially driven content solutions for brands. We work with the biggest and most impactful brands, platforms, IP, rights holders, talent and creators to drive our work.</p> <p>We passionately believe that Sports and Entertainment make modern culture. Across sport, music, fashion, gaming and entertainment, they fuel the communities and fandoms that drive audiences and power brand differentiation. The vision of our 100+ dedicated craft experts is simple – <strong>We make brands epic in culture</strong>.  </p> <p>The <strong>Associate Director, Creative Strategy</strong> is a senior role within WPP Media Sports & Entertainment. Reporting to the Director, Creative Strategy, you will sit at the intersection of human insight, cultural trends, and entertainment. Your primary mission is to turn brand objectives into culturally impactful ideas that deliver growth for our clients.</p> <p>This role bridges strategic ambition and day-to-day execution. You will be confident navigating the entire process: taking complex client briefs, developing channel-agnostic creative strategies, leading idea development alongside creative teams, and guiding those ideas as they come to life.</p> <p>As an important member of the team, you will take meaningful ownership of client relationships, actively contribute to organic growth, and mentor and manage junior strategists, acting as a trusted, day-to-day strategic partner for both internal specialist disciplines and external client teams.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <p>Strategic Leadership & Insight Generation</p> <ul> <li>Lead the development of powerful, insight-driven creative strategies that inform clear creative territories for brands.</li> <li>Uncover deep insights across consumer behavior, cultural shifts, and connection channels to unlock new opportunities.</li> <li>Reframe a brand's role in the world—moving it from a product people buy to a cultural story they want to actively participate in.</li> <li>Integrate Creative Strategy expertise seamlessly within the wider media Planning process.</li> </ul> <p>Creative Development & Collaboration</p> <ul> <li>Work closely with creative, partnership, and specialist teams to develop high-quality, channel-agnostic ideas that deliver cultural impact and commercial outcomes.</li> <li>Create the optimal conditions for creative ideas to flourish, supporting teams as they bring concepts to life.</li> <li>Connect client briefs to culturally relevant platforms, talent, rights holders, broadcasters, and creators.</li> <li>Stay at the forefront of emerging cultural trends, social platforms, and technologies (e.g., WPP Open) to keep our strategic output cutting-edge.</li> </ul> <p>Client & Account Leadership</p> <ul> <li>Take senior day-to-day ownership of strategic accounts, building trusted, consultative relationships with key client contacts.</li> <li>Act as a specialist advisor to clients, helping them navigate opportunities across sport, music, gaming, fashion, and entertainment.</li> <li>Deliver compelling client presentations and pitches, articulating complex strategic narratives with ease and confidence.</li> <li>Partner with Client Directors to identify opportunities for organic business growth, upselling, and expanded scopes of work.</li> </ul> <p>Team Management & Upskilling</p> <ul> <li>You will mentor, and support the wider department’s team members, providing clear direction, constructive feedback, and career growth support.</li> <li>Foster a collaborative, creative, and strategically rigorous team culture.</li> <li>Upskill and train the wider agency team on core strategic competencies, such as insight generation, territory development, and brief writing.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Experience</strong> in creative strategy, brand planning, or partnership planning within an agency, media owner, sports, or entertainment business.</li> <li><strong>End-to-End Strategic Prowess:</strong> Proven experience taking a project from the initial client brief, through deep insight and strategic territory mapping, to creative execution.</li> <li><strong>Cultural Native:</strong> A deep understanding of and passion for the branded entertainment, sport, gaming, and cultural marketing landscape.</li> <li><strong>Collaborative Mindset:</strong> Strong collaborative skills to deliver multidisciplinary, integrated campaigns alongside diverse internal and external teams.</li> <li><strong>People Management:</strong> Experience managing or mentoring junior team members with a genuine commitment to helping others develop.</li> <li><strong>Communication & Storytelling:</strong> Exceptional client-facing skills, with a track record of presenting complex strategic concepts clearly and persuasively.</li> <li>What Success Looks Like</li> <li><strong>Impactful Work:</strong> Your client portfolio consistently delivers highly innovative, channel-agnostic creative strategies that generate real cultural buzz.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory:</strong> Clients value you as a vital, senior day-to-day strategic partner, resulting in strong retention and expanded scopes of work.</li> <li><strong>Team Growth:</strong> The junior strategists and executives under your guidance are visibly progressing in their strategic craft, confidence, and output.</li> <li><strong>Internal Leadership:</strong> You are recognised as a core driver of creative and strategic excellence within the WPP Media Sports & Entertainment network.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media & Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. </p> <p>We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. </p> <p>WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. </p> <p>Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location.</p> <p>Please read our Privacy Notice (<a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy">https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy</a>) for more information on how we process the information you provide. </p> <p>While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted. </p> <p>#LI-Promoted</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"> <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":276}"> </span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
