title: Senior Localization Specialist, Italian
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><span style="font-size: 18pt;"><strong>About Taskrabbit:</strong></span></h2> <p>Taskrabbit is a marketplace platform that conveniently connects people with Taskers to handle everyday home to-do’s, such as furniture assembly, handyman work, moving help, and much more.</p> <p>At Taskrabbit, we want to transform lives one task at a time. As a company we celebrate innovation, inclusion and hard work. Our culture is collaborative, pragmatic, and fast-paced. We’re looking for talented, entrepreneurially minded and data-driven people who also have a passion for helping people do what they love. Together with IKEA, we’re creating more opportunities for people to earn a consistent, meaningful income on their own terms by building lasting relationships with clients in communities around the world.</p> <p>Taskrabbit is a hybrid company with employees distributed across the US and EU and a Built In — Best Places to Work (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025) continually ranked across multiple national and regional categories. Join us at Taskrabbit, where your work will be meaningful, your ideas valued, and your potential unleashed!</p></div><p><strong>This role is based in London and candidates must have the existing right to work in the UK. Taskrabbit is a hybrid company, with employees working 2 days per week in our dedicated office space in Central London (Soho). </strong></p> <p> </p> <h3>About the role:</h3> <p>The Globalization team sits within the Product organization and ensures the Taskrabbit experience is fully localized and culturally resonant across all our international markets: Canada, the UK, France, Germany, Spain, Portugal, and Italy. We are growth partners and brand guardians for Marketing, Product, Partnerships, and Tasker Operations, among many other departments, elevating brand recognition and unlocking net revenue everywhere.</p> <p>We are seeking an experienced Senior Localization Specialist to join the team, managing all localization needs with expertise on the Italian locale. In this role, you will balance global localization project management across all markets, including high-touch, complex requests outside our automated pipeline, with full ownership of your language. You will be a strategic architect of our international presence: serving as the cultural bridge between our global product and the Italian market, ensuring our mission to transform lives feels assolutamente autentica, and collaborating with the wider Italian team to bring a strategy to life. You will coordinate translation work with our dedicated external agencies and contractors, and you will also adapt, proofread, edit, or transcreate content. Ideally, you will also contribute creatively to content development by writing original copy.</p> <p>You will own the evolution of our linguistic assets with the rest of the Globalization team, including glossaries, style guides, but also multilingual guidelines and resources used by all departments. As an internal consultant, you will support stakeholders with expert guidance on cultural nuances and globalization best practices across all territories.</p> <p>As part of our small but mighty international team, you will enjoy the autonomy to truly shape your role while exploring and implementing innovative tech solutions. Taskrabbit is a data-driven and values-driven company; your work will have a direct impact on the progress of our business and the lives of the communities we serve across all our markets.</p> <p> </p> <h3>What you will work on:</h3> <ul> <li>Manage global localization workflows on Smartling across all markets and locales, with dedicated in-house oversight and review for Italian.</li> <li>Orchestrate work with our dedicated translation agencies and build deep, collaborative relationships with internal and external stakeholders.</li> <li>Develop and maintain reference materials for linguists, to keep a consistent voice in your locale and ensure best practices.</li> <li>Perform Quality Assurance checks to ensure our comms, resources and UX are of the highest standard and they adhere to our linguistic assets.</li> <li>Adapt and/or review content directly on our TMS (Smartling).</li> <li>Test and assess AI-driven workflows to scale our operations and improve efficiency, while maintaining localization quality.</li> <li>Carry out comprehensive localization audits, testing the full user journey to remove friction and enhance the customer experience and our performance metrics.</li> <li>Project manage cross-functional international initiatives, working with remote teams in different areas and time zones.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3>What we are looking for:</h3> <ul> <li>An Italian localization expert.</li> <li>A passion for language, communication, and storytelling.</li> <li>A minimum of 5 years hands-on localization experience, with a strong background in translation, linguistics, transcreation, content creation, QA, and cultural adaptation.</li> <li>Excellent communication and organization skills. You are capable of carrying out all duties in a fast-paced environment as part of a hybrid international team.</li> <li>Solid understanding of CAT tools, including familiarity with MT and AI-driven workflows and tools.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to move from reactive translation management to proactive global strategy, identifying and solving complex workflow and content challenges.</li> <li>An experienced project manager, capable of working cross-functionally, managing expectations, understanding priorities, and delivering on time.</li> <li>A seasoned specialist who understands the nature, needs and nuances of different content types: Marketing, Product and Engineering, Customer Support, Partnerships, etc.</li> <li>A forensic eye for detail and a strong curiosity about how things work.</li> <li>A clear, kind, and considerate professional who takes pride in a job well done.</li> <li>A team player—You’ll be joining a small, cohesive team.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><strong>Compensation & Benefits: </strong></h2> <p>At Taskrabbit, our approach to compensation is designed to be competitive, transparent, and equitable. Total compensation consists of base pay + bonus + <a href="https://www.taskrabbit.com/careers">benefits + perks.</a></p> <p>The base pay range for this position is <strong>£49,000 - $£60,000. </strong>This range is representative of base pay only, and does not include any other total cash compensation amounts, such as company bonus or benefits. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed above and will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, relevant experience, qualifications, geography, and level.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><span style="font-size: 18pt;"><strong>You’ll love working here because:</strong></span></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Taskrabbit is a Hybrid Company.</strong> We value flexibility and choice but also stay committed to regular in-person connection.</li> <li><strong>The People.</strong> You will be surrounded by some of the most talented, supportive, smart, and kind leaders and teams -- people you can be proud to work with!</li> <li><strong>The Diverse Culture.</strong> We believe that we make better decisions when our workforce reflects the diversity of the communities in which we operate. Women make up half of our leadership team and our diversity representation is above that of the tech industry average.</li> <li><strong>The Perks.</strong> Taskrabbit offers our employees with employer-paid health insurance and a 401k match with immediate vesting for our US based employees. We offer all of our global employees generous and flexible time off with 2 company-wide closure weeks, Taskrabbit product stipends, wellness + productivity + education stipends, IKEA discounts, reproductive health support, and more. <strong>Benefits vary by country of employment. </strong></li> </ul> <h2><span style="font-size: 18pt;"><strong>Taskrabbit’s commitment to Diversity and Inclusion:</strong></span></h2> <p>An Active Commitment to Equity within our Company and Platform. We are an inclusive community where all who share our mission and values belong. Our diverse team represents the communities we serve, breaking down systemic barriers, and transforming lives- one action at a time.</p> <p>Taskrabbit is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, military/veteran status, or disability status. Taskrabbit is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodation to applicants with physical and mental disabilities. Taskrabbit will consider for employment all qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law. </p> <p><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><strong>AI-Assisted Prescreening Notice [US Based Candidates Only]</strong>: As part of our hiring process, we may use artificial intelligence tools to assist with the initial prescreening of applications and responses. This tool does not make hiring decisions — every application and response is reviewed by a member of our recruiting team to determine fit for the role. If you would prefer not to have your application processed using this tool, you may opt out by selecting 'opt out' in the application form or by emailing <a ---------- and your application will be reviewed manually with no impact on your candidacy.</span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><a href="https://fin.ai/">Fin</a>, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.</p> <p>Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.</p> <p>Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.</p></div><h1><strong>Senior Data Scientist - Growth</strong></h1> <h2><strong>What's the opportunity? </strong></h2> <p>The Research, Analytics & Data Science (RAD) team at Fin use data and insights to drive evidence-based decision-making. We're a team of data scientists and product researchers who use data - both big and small  to unlock actionable insights about our customers, our products and our business. We generate insights that build customer empathy, drive product strategy and shape products that deliver real value to our customers. If you get really excited about asking the right questions, exploring patterns in data and surfacing actionable insights that drive strategic decisions, then this role is for you.</p> <p>Growth Data Scientists in RAD partner with the product teams who own our self-serve signup flow, our trial experience and onboarding, our checkout flow and our Startup Programs. This role will enable you to drive key data projects that directly impact the thousands of companies who sign up for Fin every week.</p> <h2><strong>What will I be doing? </strong></h2> <ul> <li>You’ll identify opportunities to improve our in-product trial experience and ultimately conversion by analysing usage, reviewing customer feedback and studying competitor products </li> <li>You’ll design experiments and measure outcomes to understand the impact of changes to our signup flow, trial experience and checkout flow</li> <li>You’ll review the performance of our Startup programs to make sure that they are attracting the right prospects and that the incentives are driving feature adoption </li> <li>You’ll contribute to projects that improve the tools and infrastructure that data scientists use to do their work.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What experience and skills do I need? </strong></h2> <ul> <li>5+ years experience working as a data scientist or analyst</li> <li>Excellent communication skills and a focus on impact</li> <li>Decent experience leveraging AI tools (e.g. Cursor, Claude Code) for data science work</li> <li>Strong SQL skills</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Bonus skills & attributes </strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience working on a B2B SaaS product</li> <li>Experience partnering with Qualitative Research teams</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Unleash Your Potential</strong></p> <p>When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.</p> <p>In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements. Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at<a href="http://fin.ai/careers"> fin.ai/careers</a>. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. </p> <p><strong>Policies </strong></p> <p>Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.</p> <p>We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our <a href="https://www.intercom.com/careers">core values</a>.  </p> <p>Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. description: About Pleo Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’. The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years. Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together. Please note: Applications will be open until 3rd October 2026 at 10.00 CEST. We will not review any application before the closing window so, please, don't rush to apply and ensure you use the time to submit a high quality, personalised application. About the role Growth Intelligence owns the commercial data layer that powers Pleo's GTM engine — acquisition, retention, propensity modelling, and customer health. The team supports RevOps, Customer Experience, Customer Success, and senior commercial leadership with the data and models they need to make faster, smarter decisions. As a Staff Full Stack Data Analyst, you are the senior technical voice for commercial analytics at Pleo. You set the architectural direction for Growth Intelligence's analytics layer, define what good looks like for the team, and shape how GTM data is structured, governed, and consumed by people and increasingly by AI tools. You bring technical depth, commercial instinct, and organisational reach in equal measure. You move between architecture reviews and executive presentations, between defining metric contracts and mentoring the analysts who implement them. You don't just answer questions - you identify the right ones, and you make sure the answers compound over time. Who you'll work with You will report to the Senior Manager of the Growth Intelligence team. You will partner closely with senior commercial leadership, Customer Experience, Sales, and Customer Success teams; the onboarding and self-serve product teams; Data Scientists and Analytics Engineers across the broader data organization; and Data Services & Governance on standards and semantic layer ownership. You will be a visible, senior presence across the entire data community at Pleo. What you'll be doing Own the architectural direction of the analytics layer for customer acquisition, onboarding, growth, and retention. You'll be making systemic decisions about how models are structured, layered, and governed, not just what gets built next. Identify and resolve upstream data quality issues at source, treating quality gaps as governance and contract problems, articulating the business risk they create, and driving the org-level changes needed to fix them durably. Define canonical GTM metric definitions in the semantic layer, in partnership with Data Services & Governance while ensuring RevOps, CS, CX, BI tools, and AI tooling are working from the same source of truth, and holding that standard over time. Partner with senior commercial leadership to shape the questions worth answering. Lead in-depth analysis of customer behaviour, commercial performance, and retention patterns. Design and govern the team's approach to experimentation ensuring statistical rigour, scalable methodology, and clear criteria for what constitutes a meaningful result. Build analytics explicitly architected for self-serve and AI access: structured, documented, and reliable enough for business teams, conversational analytics tools, and AI features to consume autonomously. Mentor and develop analysts on the team through code reviews, design discussions, and deliberate knowledge-sharing, raising the collective standard of analytical craft. Contribute to engineering and analytical standards across the broader data community, participating in cross-team reviews and helping define what production-grade analytics looks like at Pleo. For extra context, you'll also be leveraging technologies including SQL, dbt, BigQuery, Looker, Amplitude, HubSpot, Zuora, or Vitally. What you bring Prior experience operating at Staff or Lead level in data analytics or analytics engineering roles in a fast-paced SaaS organisation. Expert knowledge of SQL and dbt: you write clean, tested, well-architected models and can make and defend layering decisions for a team, not just yourself. Solid proficiency with Python for data analysis and manipulation. Comfort with Git-based workflows and CI/CD practices for analytics code. BigQuery fluency, including performance optimization and cost considerations at scale. Mastery of a modern BI tool such as Looker or Omni. Commercial specialisation: you have worked in a commercial analytics focused role and understand GTM metrics, customer lifecycle economics, and how data connects to revenue outcomes at a strategic level. Systems thinking on data quality: you approach quality gaps as governance questions, identify root causes upstream, and drive fixes that last rather than patches that don't. Strong understanding of data contracts: schema ownership, SLAs, and the organizational dynamics required to make producer-consumer agreements stick. Understanding of how analytics outputs serve AI tools and self-serve analytics as first-class consumers: you design for machine access as well as human access, and you know why metric consistency becomes critical as AI tooling scales. Track record of advising senior GTM stakeholders around shaping the question as much as answering it, and communicating risk and tradeoffs clearly to non-technical leaders. Experience mentoring analysts and raising team capability Why this role is a good fit for you This role is a good fit for you if: You excel at turning large, interconnected and complex problems into well structured, clearly defined and pragmatic solutions. If you are comfortable navigating ambiguity within a fast-paced SaaS organisation, and can generate clarity, you'll find this role very exciting. You find hands-on technical work as exciting as stakeholders management, delivery management and governance strategy. You have operated as a Technical Lead for Commercial / Growth Analytics within a 500+ people SaaS organisation and understand the recurring topics, challenges and goals businesses of our scale experience. This role is NOT a good fit for you if: You prefer to specialise deeply in one technical area rather than wear multiple hats. This role requires you to move between architecture, analysis, experimentation, stakeholder management, and mentoring. You are not comfortable operating at senior leadership level and shaping ambiguous commercial questions into solvable data problems. You'll often need to define what success looks like before you can measure it. You need clean problem definitions before you can start. The commercial data environment here is genuinely complex: definitions evolve, ownership is shared, and the right answer sometimes requires organisational negotiation as much as analysis. You think of standards and governance as someone else's job. At this level, you are part of how the organisation decides what good looks like. How you'll develop in this role By the end of your first six months, you will have left the analytics layer in structurally better shape, not just fixed individual dashboards, but addressed the underlying quality, governance, and architectural gaps that were causing repeated pain for RevOps, CS, and CX teams. You will have driven at least one meaningful governance outcome: canonical GTM metric definitions agreed with Data Services & Governance, embedded in the semantic layer, and actively used so that analysts, BI tools, and AI features are working from the same numbers. You will have established yourself as a trusted partner to commercial leadership, not just the person who delivers the analysis, but the person they bring in when they're not sure what question to ask. You will have shipped something that changed what was possible: not improved plumbing, but unlocked a capability or decision that couldn't have happened without you. Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis 25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards). For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work The interview process We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows: Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background. title: Performance Marketing Manager
description: About Bike Club We're customer obsessed. We put the customer at the heart of everything we do - and we're looking for people who feel the same way. Bike Club is changing the way families access children's bikes. Through our subscription model, we make it easy for families to get the right bike at the right time, while keeping bikes in circulation for longer. We are a purpose-led, fast-growing business with a strong focus on customer growth, retention and building a more circular approach to children's cycling. The Role We are looking for a commercially driven Performance Marketing Manager to manage and improve customer acquisition across the UK and Germany. Reporting to the Marketing Director, you will be responsible for the management of the performance marketing agency and overall delivery of our paid acquisition strategy. You will manage our agency partners, monitor channel performance and use customer and commercial data to recommend where we should invest, test and optimise. This role combines performance marketing expertise with strong commercial judgement. You will work closely with Marketing, Content, Data, Product, Finance and Commercial colleagues to improve the efficiency, quality and predictability of customer acquisition. You will be comfortable moving between strategic planning and detailed performance analysis, challenging agency recommendations and turning data into clear actions. Tasks What You'll Do - Acquisition Planning Develop and deliver Bike Club's customer acquisition plans across the UK and Germany in collaboration with the Marketing Director. Translate business objectives into channel plans, campaign targets and testing priorities. Recommend how acquisition budgets should be allocated across markets, channels and campaigns. Identify new opportunities to grow customer acquisition and market penetration. Develop a clear test-and-learn roadmap across channels, audiences, propositions, creative, and landing pages. Continuously assess the effectiveness and scalability of acquisition channels**.** - Performance Marketing Manage our performance marketing agency and other acquisition partners ensuring they deliver against agreed objectives. Oversee the day-to-day performance and optimisation of paid acquisition activity across relevant channels. Lead the restructure of paid search around parent needs and intent (sizing, outgrown bikes, exchange) rather than subscription terms. Review campaign plans, media spend, targeting, creative and results, constructively challenging agency recommendations where appropriate. Track customer acquisition cost, conversion, return on advertising spend and other key measures of performance. Focus acquisition activity on acquiring high-quality, sustainable customers rather than simply driving volume. Work closely with the content team to develop strong campaign propositions, briefs and creative testing plans. Identify opportunities to improve landing pages and customer journeys. Ensure learning from campaigns and tests is documented and applied to future activity. - Commercial Performance & Data Own day-to-day reporting on acquisition KPIs, including CAC, conversion, ROAS, payback and customer value. Partner closely with Finance and Data to understand acquisition economics and profitability. Analyse performance by channel, audience, campaign, proposition and market. Develop robust forecasting and scenario planning for acquisition performance for the Marketing Director and wider business Ensure performance data is accurate, accessible and used consistently in decision-making. Present findings and recommendations clearly to both marketing specialists and wider business stakeholders. Requirements About You You'll be an experienced performance marketer who combines channel knowledge with strong commercial and analytical judgement. You'll bring: Relevant experience in performance marketing, customer acquisition or growth marketing within a consumer-focused business or agency. A strong understanding of paid acquisition channels and how they work together within the customer journey. Experience managing performance marketing agencies or external partners. A track record of improving acquisition performance while maintaining commercial discipline. Strong analytical and commercial skills, with the ability to translate data into practical recommendations. Experience developing and evaluating campaign tests across audiences, creative, propositions or channels. Experience managing a multi-channel, multi-market budget of £1m+, including making investment recommendations A test-and-learn mindset and genuine curiosity about what drives customer behaviour. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. Experience working across multiple markets, ideally including Germany is desirable. What Success Looks Like In your first 12 months, you will have: Delivered the acquisition plan in the UK and Germany hitting targets and establishing ways of working for future growth. Improved the efficiency and predictability of customer acquisition. Established clear acquisition KPIs and reporting. Built an effective and accountable relationship with our performance marketing agency. Developed a structured programme of testing across channels, audiences, propositions and creative. Identified and scaled the strongest acquisition opportunities. Improved collaboration between Marketing, Data, Product, Finance and Commercial teams. Benefits 🌴We offer 26 days per year + bank holidays 💷Pension salary sacrifice 🏡Enhanced Maternity and Paternity Leave 🚴Employee Discount on our bikes Why BikeClub? You'll be joining a business with a clear purpose, a genuinely different proposition and significant opportunity to grow. This is an opportunity to have a meaningful impact on the next stage of Bike Club's growth, while helping build a more sustainable way for families to access children's bikes. This means assessing what's out there, testing what fits, and identifying where it can raise the quality and scale of our creative output.</p> <p><strong>Tooling selection and RFP:</strong> Running RFPs for Marketing tooling, particularly for a Digital Asset Management (DAM) system. You’ll own the tactical rollout of our alpha, beta, and mass-market launches. Working closely with our central Product and Marketing channels, you’ll ensure all touchpoints - from the website and CRM to creative and messaging - are built, localized, and ready to go. You will act as the crucial link between our central teams and our local country Marketing Leads to set every new market up for success.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <p> </p> <ul> <li>Go-to-Market Launch & Marketing: Executing and helping build a plan for Business Banking launches in new markets, including media/channel strategies, communication tactics, and integrated marketing campaigns. </li> <li>Integrated Marketing across channels: Developing and implementing marketing plans across multiple channels, including digital, social, and traditional media. </li> <li>Creative problem-solver: Working with the team to market to a new audience and find innovative ways to grow the brand. </li> <li>Tackling ambiguity: You can take away ambiguous business problems or customer challenges and come up with a plan to tackle them.</li> <li>Keeping everyone aligned: In a fast-moving expansion, you think ahead and communicate ahead of time, setting a rhythm of updates and anticipating stakeholder questions.</li> <li>Working with Creative and Media agencies: Partnering with best in class agencies and own day to day agency management. </li> <li>Media and Communications: Working in partnership with our Communications Team to execute on strategies to build brand awareness and drive engagement.</li> <li>Stakeholder Management: Working with stakeholders within Monzo to align marketing efforts with overall business objectives. </li> <li>Brand Consistency: Upholding Monzo's brand identity and values while adapting to the nuances of the local market. Ensure consistency in messaging and branding across all touchpoints.</li> <li>Reporting: Working with data teams to report frequently on key metrics, providing insights and actions.</li> <li>Regulatory Compliance: Navigating the regulatory landscape in Italy to ensure all marketing activities adhere to local regulation</li> </ul> <p><strong>We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have a proven track record of launching new products or entering new markets, and have owned medium-sized projects that required cross-team collaboration and have delivered them successfully. </li> <li>You're hands-on and comfortable executing campaigns, building websites, and configuring CRM journeys.</li> <li>You’re comfortable working in complex environments. You have experience working on hard problems or in fast-paced, dynamic teams. You’ve worked with lots of people at different levels and disciplines. You cut through complexity quickly.</li> <li>You’re happy being accountable for results.<strong> </strong>You have a track record of achieving ambitious business results, and you’re comfortable being assessed on that basis. You know how to prioritise your work for maximum impact.</li> <li>You are a self-starter and have a proactive, positive attitude and love turning complex, moving parts into a seamless customer launch experience.</li> <li>Experience in tech or finance for sole traders or SMBs is a huge plus.</li> </ul> <p><strong>The Interview Process</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p>Our interview process involves three main stages:</p> <ul> <li>Introduction call with a member of the hiring team (30 minutes)</li> <li>Initial call with the hiring manager (30 minutes)</li> <li>Role specific interview (45 minutes) & a cross-functional collaboration and behavioural interview (45 minutes)</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>You’ll hear from us throughout the application process, but if you’ve got any questions, please reach out to hiring@monzo.com. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. <br><br>#LI-JB1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. This is a rare opportunity to shape one of Monzo’s most strategically important product areas, leading teams to build innovative, differentiated experiences that no other bank offers.</p> <p>You’ll set the long-term vision, craft a customer-obsessed strategy, and create the execution engine that turns ambition into reality. We’re looking for someone who pairs exceptional product taste with strong analytical depth, thrives in ambiguity, and can inspire multiple teams to deliver world-class outcomes.</p> <p>If you’re excited by the idea of redefining business banking for millions of customers—and building high-performing teams along the way—this role puts you at the heart of Monzo’s next chapter.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll be working on:</strong></p> <p>As the Senior Product Director for Business Banking, you will define and drive the product strategy, vision, and execution for one of Monzo’s most strategically important product areas. You’ll craft an ambitious roadmap rooted in deep customer insight, emerging market dynamics, and commercial impact—setting a vision that differentiates Monzo in the business banking space.</p> <p>This role is a rare blend of strategic thinking, world-class product taste, analytical depth, and an ability to consistently ship great work. You will cultivate a high-performance, ownership-driven culture across multiple product teams, guiding them to innovate, execute, and scale products that meaningfully improve the financial lives of our business customers.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do:</strong></p> <p><strong>Product Strategy & Vision</strong></p> <ul> <li>Set a bold, customer-centric, commercially grounded product strategy for Business Banking.</li> <li>Develop and articulate a compelling long-term product vision that positions Monzo as the leader in differentiated business financial experiences.</li> <li>Combine customer insights, market trends, and commercial priorities into a roadmap that delivers measurable business impact.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Innovation & Differentiation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Foster a culture of innovation that challenges conventions and inspires teams to build category-defining experiences.</li> <li>Identify and pursue opportunities to meaningfully differentiate Monzo’s business banking offerings.</li> <li>Drive teams to create unique, delightful products based on exceptional product taste.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Analytical & Strategic Depth</strong></p> <ul> <li>Spar with data scientists and use data to understand “the why” behind customer behaviour, product performance, and opportunities.</li> <li>Help teams deepen their analytical thinking, improving decision-making quality across the org.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Execution & High-Performance Culture</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build an execution engine that consistently delivers against ambitious goals.</li> <li>Create extreme clarity on priorities, establish strong processes, remove blockers, and maintain team momentum.</li> <li>Instil a culture of ownership, speed, and high performance.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Leadership & Organisational Impact</strong></p> <ul> <li>Be a self-starter with a strong bias for action—willing to lead from the front when needed and empower from behind when that’s best.</li> <li>Take full ownership of the Business Banking product area, operating with autonomy and accountability.</li> <li>Identify organisational inefficiencies and design structures that enable teams to thrive.</li> <li>Hire, coach, and develop exceptional product managers, helping them reach their full potential and cultivating the next generation of Monzo product leaders.</li> </ul> <p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You are a seasoned product leader, and have a track record of leading high-performing product teams at a fast-growing consumer tech company to:</li> <ul> <li>build highly engaging (daily/weekly) experiences for millions of customers</li> <li>deliver company trajectory-changing impact</li> <li>(nice-to-have) build a multi-market product, with a proven ability to balance priorities across geographies</li> </ul> <li>You're data-driven and commercial, and have a track record of collaborating with data scientists to define key metrics, run experiments, and deliver business impact.</li> <li>You can systematically break down and solve complex problems.</li> <li>You have good judgement, and you’re able to make good decisions in complex situations where there’s often no “right answer”. </li> <li>You have the urge and resilience to challenge the status quo and make things better, and are full of creative ideas for how to do so.</li> <li>You can work effectively with a diverse range of people and working styles - spanning engineering, design, data, user research, marketing, legal and compliance - to get stuff done.</li> <li>You’re a great storyteller, who is able to motivate, energise and inspire people towards a common goal.</li> <li>You’re passionate about building value for customers and not just achieving business results, and are excited about our mission at Monzo.</li> <li>You’re intellectually honest about your work's performance, continually striving for improvement. </li> <li>You’re a fast learner, humble and curious, and enjoy learning every day and sharing your knowledge and experience.</li> <li>You’ve managed a team of PMs, have a proven ability to coach and develop others, and can provide clear and constructive feedback to your team and other disciplines.</li> <li>You can get hands-on when necessary, to fill gaps - in people or experience - and set a practical example for what great looks like.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What’s in it for you:</strong></p> <p>💰Base salary dependent upon experience + Stock Options + Benefits</p> <p>✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK  </p> <p>✅ We can sponsor visas</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.</p> <p>📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>➕And much more, Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p><strong>📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰Competitive base salary and stock options |<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Benefits</a></strong></p> <p><strong>Help build the future of customer operations</strong></p> <p>We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. Operations is at the heart of that mission. It’s where we help millions of customers, solve complex problems and keep Monzo safe. Now, we’re redesigning how customer operations work by bringing together intelligent automation, human expertise and world-class technology.</p> <p>We’re looking for a <strong>Staff Technical Program Manager</strong> to lead complex company wide programmes driven by the Operations collective. You’ll turn ambitious ideas into clear plans, bring a large and varied group of partners with you and help teams deliver lasting change.</p> <p>This role is about more than keeping work on track. You’ll shape how we work across the collective, influence domain and collective leaders across Monzo, connect technical delivery to operational outcomes and make sure change works for the people who use it every day.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <p><strong>Lead programmes that cut through all operational domains at Monzo</strong></p> <p>You’ll lead high-impact programmes from strategy through to measurable outcomes. These may cover AI-powered customer support, tools that help our Customer Operations teams, or the platforms and processes behind millions of operational decisions.</p> <p><strong>Build strong partnerships at every level</strong></p> <p>You’ll work with a large and varied group of partners. This could include frontline Operations teams, subject matter experts, product and engineering teams, risk and compliance partners, senior leaders and executives.</p> <p><strong>Drive change, not just delivery</strong></p> <p>You’ll help the whole collective adopt new ways of working. You’ll understand how changes affect people, processes and technology, then build that into the programme from the start.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead end-to-end planning and execution of major product or platform programs that cross multiple teams and markets</li> <li>Manage cross-collective programmes: <ul> <li>Define programme roadmaps and milestones, set priorities, manage trade-offs, identify and manage the critical path and risks, ensure alignment with the business goals and ambition</li> <li>Collaborate and communicate with multiple stakeholders, both technical and non-technical across the business to ensure alignment and speed of delivery</li> <li>Manage dependencies, timeline and the sequencing of delivery</li> </ul> </li> <li>Drive effective decision making to remove blockers</li> <li>Ensure operational effectiveness across your collective/area</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have strong experience managing complex technology programmes or products from inception to launch</li> <li>You’re an exceptional communicator who can create clarity for technical and non-technical audiences</li> <li>You are comfortable working in a global business with a presence in multiple markets and want to be part of scaling this further</li> <li>You can work effectively with a diverse range of people and working styles to get stuff done, and are able to thoughtfully and constructively challenge and influence the people you work with</li> <li>You can make complex work easy to understand without losing the important detail</li> <li>You understand how functionality comes together (across products and platforms) to deliver value for users, and can proactively identify and mitigate delivery risks, and can propose and drive a technical solution</li> <li>You are comfortable personally diving deep into the data to make good decisions in complex situations where there’s often no “right answer”</li> <li>You can influence across teams even when you don’t manage them directly and can influence senior leaders, resolve disagreement and build alignment without relying on authority.</li> <li>You’ve driven organisation-wide change and can show how you supported adoption, not only delivery</li> </ul> <p>You don’t need to match every point. If you’re excited by the role and believe you could have an impact, we’d love to hear from you.</p> <p><strong>What makes this role different</strong></p> <p>Most companies are adding AI to existing support processes. We’re redesigning the operating model itself.</p> <p>You’ll help shape how intelligent automation and human expertise work together in a highly regulated environment. The programmes you lead will affect how teams across Operations work and how millions of customers get help.</p> <p>You’ll have the scope to influence strategy, the responsibility to turn it into action and the chance to build ways of working that scale.</p> <p><strong>How we work 💻:</strong></p> <p><strong>Locations & Flexible Working : </strong></p> <p>Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles. </p> <p>We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨</p> <p>Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.</p> <p><strong>Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life.</strong></p> <p>At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance. </p> <p>You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨</p> <p>Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>The interview process:</strong></p> <ol> <li><strong>Recruiter Call (30 mins)</strong> You'll meet our Engineering Leadership Recruiter to discuss your experience and learn more about Monzo. They'll ask you about your previous experience, in particular program execution and technical leadership. They’ll also make time to tell you about Monzo and answer your questions.</li> <li><strong>Loop Stage (3 hours)</strong> The Loop stage consists of 3 x 60 min interviews that take place over 1-2 days (depending on your availability).</li> </ol> <p>All things going well, you'll have completed the hiring process 🚀</p> <p>Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. title: Enterprise Account Executive, UKI
description: Contentsquare is the all-in-one experience intelligence platform designed to be easily used by anyone who cares about digital journeys. With our flexible and scalable platform, organizations quickly get a deep understanding of their customers’ whole online journey. We are a global leader in the experience analytics space, with a growing presence across 15 offices worldwide. We’re here to stay—and we’re looking for team members who are excited to drive impact and help us scale even further. Our aim is to create an inclusive workplace where everyone learns and succeeds. Contentsquare has built a community of individuals who are daring, understanding, and deliberate. We invite you to join us in making the complex simpler—for our customers, their customers, and each other. Important note: Be careful of scammers pretending to be from Contentsquare. We will never ask for money or contact you through random texts. Any communication from our in house Talent Acquisition team will only ever come from our contentsquare.com or ----- domain. For more information, visit our careers blog. About the job: As an Enterprise Account Executive in London you’ll help accelerate growth across the UK’s leading banks, insurance companies, and fintech businesses. You’ll work as part of an immediate close-knit team of five, while collaborating with a broader UK and global sales organisation that includes Sales Development Representatives, Solutions Engineers, Customer Success Managers, Marketing, Partnerships, and Leadership. You’ll manage a balanced portfolio of approximately 10 existing customers to renew and expand, alongside around 90 prospective accounts. Financial services is a key strategic priority for Contentsquare. It’s the newest but fastest growing vertical. In this role, you’ll help some of the UK’s most influential financial institutions make better digital decisions through Contentsquare’s experience intelligence platform and ecosystem of technology partnerships, including Microsoft and Snowflake. What you’ll do: Manage the full sales cycle for Contentsquare’s experience intelligence platform across UK financial services accounts. Develop and execute strategic enterprise account plans to drive new business, account expansion, and retention. Prospect into and build relationships with senior executives and decision-makers across Product, Marketing, Design and Data teams. Own renewal activity in close partnership with the Customer Success Manager, ensuring customers continue to realise value from Contentsquare. Establish and navigate senior-level relationships, from initial engagement through to executive sponsorship. Articulate the business value of complex enterprise technology and connect it to customers’ digital transformation priorities. Leverage Contentsquare’s broader sales ecosystem and technology partnerships to create compelling customer solutions. Represent Contentsquare as a trusted strategic partner to leading UK financial services organisations. What you’ll need to succeed: Experience selling enterprise SaaS solutions, including new business and account expansion. Experience selling into financial services is a plus, but not required. A proven track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets. Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles. The ability to articulate the business value of complex technology and link it to measurable customer outcomes. The ability to develop senior-level relationships quickly and effectively. Experience with a recognised sales methodology such as MEDDICC, SPIN, or Challenger. Motivation to work in a hybrid environment, spending three days per week in our London office. Why you should join Contentsquare We invest in our people through career development, mentorship, social events, philanthropic activities, and competitive benefits. We are always assessing the perks we offer to ensure we’re aligned with the employees' needs. Here are a few we want to highlight: - Virtual onboarding, Hackathon, and various opportunities to interact with your team and global colleagues both on and offsite each year - Work flexibility: hybrid and remote work policies - Generous paid time-off policy (every location is different) - Lifestyle allowance - A Culture Crew in every country we’re based in to coordinate regular activities for employees to get to know each other and bond outside of work - Every full-time employee receives stock options, allowing them to share in the company’s success - We have multiple Employee Resource Groups, that offer a safe space for individuals who share common identities, life experiences, or allyship to connect, support one another, and passionately advocate for the issues close to their hearts - And more benefits tailored to each country Contentsquare is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. Your personal data is used by Contentsquare for recruitment purposes only. Read our Job Candidate Privacy Notice to find out more about data protection at Contentsquare and your rights. You can exercise your rights by using our dedicated Data Subject Rights Portal here . Your personal data will be securely stored in our hosting provider’s data center in Oregon (US west). We have implemented appropriate transfer mechanisms under applicable data protection laws. Contentsquare may use AI-assisted tools to help review and screen applications. All decisions involving hiring are made by human reviewers, and your personal data will be processed in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy . Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Our Analytics organisation sits at the heart of Deliveroo powering decision-making across our 3 sided marketplace. We're looking for an Analytics Engineering Manager to join our London team. This is a hybrid role, with 3 days per week on-site. In this role, you'll lead a team of Analytics Engineers embedded in a key business domain, owning the pipelines, models and metrics that power day-to-day decisions and building the data foundations your stakeholders rely on. About the Analytics Engineering Org Analytics Engineering is a core pillar of Deliveroo's Analytics organisation, alongside Data Science. With over 70 Analytics Engineers across the UK and India, we are embedded directly within product and business domains, owning the pipelines, models and metrics that power decision-making at scale: from self-serve AI-enabled analytics and experimentation through to executive reporting and strategic planning. The discipline is evolving fast. With new tooling changing how we work, we are shifting from building data pipelines to building AI first data products, developing rich semantic and data context layers and empowering self-serve data users. This role leads that work across a defined business domain, directly managing a team of Analytics Engineers and helping shape AE standards, culture and direction across the wider org. What You'll Be Doing Directly lead a team of Analytics Engineers embedded in a defined business domain, owning their performance, development and wellbeing Own the AE roadmap for your domain, identifying the highest-leverage investments, prioritising competing requests, and building the case for them with your business and product stakeholders Drive a data products mindset across your estate: clear ownership, SLAs, observability and data contracts built into how your team works by default Maintain strong technical involvement: reviewing data models and SQL, guiding architectural decisions, and stepping in hands-on when your team needs unblocking Contribute to AE-wide decisions on tooling, standards and process, helping shape how Analytics Engineering works at Deliveroo beyond your immediate team Build a high-performing, inclusive team culture by giving regular and actionable feedback, handling performance and motivation challenges, and running effective rituals Partner with Recruiting to hire strong, diverse AE talent into your team What You'll Need to Thrive Essential Experience in an Analytics Engineering, BI Engineering, or Data Engineering role, with strong, hands-on SQL foundations you still draw on regularly Proven experience managing a team of ICs, with a track record of developing people, giving hard feedback, and handling typical team situations independently Demonstrated ability to own a technical roadmap for a domain area and deliver against it with measurable business impact Strong grounding across the modern AE stack (cloud data warehousing, transformation tooling, data modelling, and data quality practices), with the ability to engage credibly on technical decisions and unblock your team Comfortable engaging and influencing at senior business and product level, with experience aligning analytics investment to domain priorities Nice to Have Experience in a marketplace, e-commerce, grocery or retail analytics context Familiarity with semantic and metrics layer tooling, or Python for data automation and pipeline work Exposure to AI for Data, including agentic AI methods, semantic layers, or AI-assisted analytics workflows Experience contributing to analytics ways of working: documentation standards, peer review processes, onboarding, and knowledge sharing Why Join Us? At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to: 🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day. 🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment. 🧠Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support. 🌎A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning. ​​ 💰 Share in the success you help create Competitive salary and equity options, so you're rewarded for the impact you make. title: Software Engineer
description: About Wolt At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. title: Staff Engineer
description: About Wolt At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe. Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. Wolt's AdTech & Promotions team is building the systems that power how restaurants and brands grow on our platform. From campaign creation to optimization and forecasting, we develop tools that help advertisers make smarter decisions and drive measurable results. As we expand our offering, we are investing in new capabilities that combine real-time data, scalable systems, and intuitive user experiences to unlock the next phase of growth. We're looking for a Staff Engineer to join the Wolt AdTech & Promotions organization, who can drive technical direction across this space and help us build reliable, scalable systems that directly impact revenue and advertiser success. What you'll be doing Drive the technical vision and architecture for Wolt's AdTech and Promotions platforms, ensuring they are scalable, reliable, and high-performing. Provide technical leadership across multiple teams and projects, bringing architectural consistency to complex, large-scale systems. Work across the end-to-end domain , contributing to backend services, data pipelines, and advertiser-facing tools. Design and evolve systems that support campaign execution, targeting, ranking, allocation, and reporting in real-time or near real-time environments. Partner with engineering, product, and data stakeholders to align priorities, improve campaign performance, and manage trade-offs in a revenue-driven environment. Lead large cross-team projects, guiding them from concept to rollout across multiple regions and time zones. Ensure strong operational excellence, including observability, reliability, and incident readiness for revenue-critical systems. Promote best engineering practices, mentor engineers across teams, and support their growth in scalability and system design. Act as a bridge between technical and non-technical colleagues, ensuring clarity and alignment across functions. Contribute to the technical roadmaps of AdTech and Promotions platforms by collaborating with other senior engineers. This position is based in London Our humble expectations Technical Expertise Proven track record designing and scaling large distributed systems in production environments . Strong understanding of system architecture, scalability, reliability, and performance optimization. Experience working with data-intensive and real-time or near real-time systems . Familiarity with AdTech concepts such as targeting, ranking, attribution, or experimentation is a strong plus. Ability to adapt quickly to new technologies and languages; while many of our services are written in Kotlin and Go, we are looking for someone language-agnostic. Ability to dive quickly into new domains and navigate complex system interactions. Familiarity with modern cloud-native tools and data systems (e.g., Kubernetes, Kafka, MongoDB). Communication & Influence Strong communicator with the ability to influence, align, and build consensus across diverse teams and stakeholders. Comfortable working in a global environment across US and international teams . Skilled at translating complex technical decisions into clear direction for technical and non-technical audiences. Experience mentoring and coaching engineers, helping raise the technical bar across teams. Strong sense of ownership combined with a collaborative mindset , able to work effectively across team boundaries to deliver shared outcomes. Proactive in identifying opportunities and gaps across teams , and driving alignment to solve problems holistically rather than locally. What we offer At Wolt, this role provides a rare opportunity to work on challenging AdTech problems at scale , where technical decisions directly impact revenue and user experience. Our compensation follows a total compensation model , combining a competitive base salary with DoorDash RSUs. You will play a key role in building and evolving the next generation of advertisement tools and platforms , shaping how advertisers create, manage, and optimize campaigns across Wolt. This is not just about maintaining systems, but about defining and scaling new capabilities in a fast-growing domain . As a Staff Engineer, you will have end-to-end ownership and high autonomy , with the ability to influence architecture, product direction, and engineering practices across teams. Your work will have clear, measurable business impact , directly contributing to revenue growth and advertiser success. You'll be part of a global company operating at scale , collaborating with teams across Europe and the US, and solving problems that span multiple markets, use cases, and customer segments. This role also offers strong opportunities for career growth and scope expansion , whether through deep technical leadership, cross-domain influence, or progression toward more senior individual contributor roles. Alongside the technical challenge, you'll work with talented engineers and leaders in a diverse and international environment , shaping both our systems and engineering culture while mentoring and learning from others. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. Our brands and people exist to break boundaries, to power and empower those who want more.</p> <p data-start="143" data-end="197"><strong data-start="143" data-end="197">Why be a Senior Influencer Executive for Germany Myprotein?</strong></p> <p data-start="199" data-end="877">At Myprotein, we’re more than just a sports nutrition brand, we’re a global movement driven by passion, innovation and our mission to <em data-start="346" data-end="366">Fuel your ambition</em>. You’ll work alongside a passionate, high-performing marketing team and play a pivotal role in scaling our influencer strategy in one of our fastest-growing markets. This is a unique chance to blend creativity, strategic thinking, and cultural insight, all while working with some of the most exciting talent in the German fitness and wellbeing space.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities include:</strong></p> <ul> <li data-start="191" data-end="408">Own and drive the day-to-day operations of the German influencer programme, ensuring consistent growth and performance, while maintaining strong working relationships with creators and talent agents in the region.</li> <li data-start="412" data-end="587">Support the Senior Influencer Manager – EU in communications.</li> <li data-start="1003" data-end="1238">Actively source and recruit new German influencer talent, with a focus on brand alignment, commercial potential, and cultural fit – from micro creators to emerging macro talent – to support customer acquisition and brand awareness.</li> <li data-start="1242" data-end="1466">Collaborate cross-functionally with key stakeholders including content, brand, commercial, paid media and product marketing teams to plan, brief, and execute integrated influencer campaigns tailored to the German market.</li> <li data-start="1470" data-end="1636">Own the full campaign process for German influencer activations – from planning and briefing, to execution, approvals, content collection, analysis and learnings.</li> <li and authenticity.</li> <li data-start="1832" data-end="2028">Lead on German influencer payments and budget tracking, ensuring accurate and timely invoicing and monthly purchase order (PO) processes are completed in line with internal finance procedures.</li> <li data-start="2032" data-end="2256">Encourage collaboration across influencer tiers, nurturing an engaged community through creative activations, collaborative content opportunities and connections with wider marketing channels (e.g., events, social, CRM).</li> <li data-start="2260" data-end="2416">Support brand-led events, in Germany , identifying emerging platforms, content formats, and creator trends to future-proof Myprotein’s influencer approach and maintain brand relevance.</li> </ul> <p><strong>We're looking marketing</li> <li>An understanding of how influencers can play a key role in building brand awareness, affinity, content creation and driving commercial value for brands</li> <li>Deep knowledge of current and emerging German social media platforms including but not limited to Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok etc.</li> <li>Outstanding communication, negotiation and organisational skills</li> <li>A proactive self-starter with a problem-solving attitude and the ability to meet deadlines</li> <li>Knowledge of the German fitness industry and social media trends</li> </ul> Enjoy your day off on us!</li> <li>Enhanced maternity and paternity pay, depending on length of service.</li> <li>Up to 10 days compassionate leave.</li> <li>Buy back up to 3 days each year.</li> <li>Unlock 2 days volunteer leave after 12-months.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wellbeing Support</strong></p> <ul> <li>Access face-to-face and virtual appointments with our in-house GP.</li> <li>Access our in-house CBT therapist.</li> <li>Access our 247 Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) which is provided by Bupa.</li> <li>State-of-the-art on-site gym.</li> <li>Access to our on-site physio.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Other Perks</strong></p> <ul> <li>Save up to 12% on the cost of personal tech through our salary sacrifice scheme.</li> <li>Subsidised bus pass from Manchester City Centre to our ICON office.</li> <li>Up to 50% staff discount on THG brands.</li> <li>On-site staff shop.</li> <li>Access to on-site barber.</li> <li>Know someone who would be perfect for THG? title: Head of Data Engineering & Governance
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">About THG</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":160,"335559740":279}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We are THG, a global ecommerce group on a mission to be the global online leader in beauty and sports nutrition.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":240,"335559739":240,"335559740":279}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Our portfolio of</span><span data-contrast="auto"> leading retailers and brands such as LOOKFANTASTIC, Myprotein, ESPA, Perricone MD, and Cult Beauty form our two core businesses: THG Beauty and THG Nutrition.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":240,"335559739":240,"335559740":279}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">From Manchester to New York, we’re powered by a team of over 2500 people who work together, lead by example, and think BIG. </span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">With us, you’ll go further, faster. What are you waiting for?</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":240,"335559739":240,"335559740":279}"> </span></p></div><p><strong>Location: Icon 1, WA15 0AF</strong></p> <p><strong>About Central Functions</strong></p> <p>Central Functions is formed of the teams and people that serve the entire business. These people are integral to the smooth running of the business; ensuring everyone is paid on time, that materials are sourced and arrive promptly, that we meet our legal obligations and that our health, safety, and security is safeguarded.</p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Why be the Head of Data Engineering and Governance at THG?</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":160,"335559740":279}"> </span></p> <p>THG is building a world-class data function to power one of the UK's largest e-commerce businesses. As Head of Engineering & Governance, you will own the quality, availability and structure of the data that enables every business-facing team across our Beauty and Nutrition divisions.</p> <p>This is not a systems infrastructure role. You are not managing foundational platform plumbing — that sits with our technology partner, Ingenuity. Your remit is the layer above that: how data is structured, governed, made available and used across the business. You will set the direction for how THG gets the most from its data ecosystem, ensuring that analytics teams, data scientists, and business leaders can trust and act on the data they see.</p> <p>You will lead three distinct functions: Engineering (how we build, structure and maintain our data domains), Governance (how we ensure quality, consistency and trust), and Reporting (how we present business performance data consistently across PLC). You will work closely with Ingenuity, who provide the foundational platform and first-layer pipelines, to set requirements and standards that flow through from ingestion to insight.</p> <p>We are at an early stage of this journey. Our data foundations need significant work — we have talented analysts who have been doing engineering work without the structure or tools to do it well, governance that is essentially non-existent, and reporting that has grown organically without consistency. You will shape and deliver the roadmap that fixes this.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do:</strong></p> <p><strong>Strategic Direction</strong></p> <ul> <li>Set the vision and roadmap for data engineering, governance and reporting across THG PLC</li> <li>Define how data domains (Customer, Commercial, Operations) should be structured, stored and made available for analytics, data science and AI use cases</li> <li>Own the relationship with Ingenuity on platform and data matters — setting requirements, managing dependencies and ensuring PLC needs are reflected in the Ingen roadmap</li> <li>Evaluate where THG should use Ingen capability versus external tooling, and ensure every technology choice is documented and commercially justified</li> <li>Drive the business towards a single source of truth — reducing data silos, resolving mastering conflicts, and building confidence in our data across the organisation</li> </ul> <p><strong>Engineering & Data Platform</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead the Engineering team in building and maintaining the data pipelines, domain datasets and platform architecture that underpin analytics across Beauty and Nutrition</li> <li>Own the evolution of our GCP/BigQuery platform — from how data is ingested and stored, to how it is structured for downstream consumption</li> <li>Set engineering standards — version control, testing, error handling, documentation — and ensure they are consistently applied</li> <li>Champion the use of AI and automation in data engineering — this is a small team that needs to move fast, and we expect the use of AI-assisted pipeline development and management to be embedded in how we work</li> </ul> <p><strong>Data Governance</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead the Data Governance function from a standing start — we have no established governance framework and this is a greenfield opportunity to build it properly</li> <li>Own the framework for how THG manages data quality, metadata, data definitions and lineage across PLC</li> <li>Work with Ingenuity to ensure governance standards are consistent across both PLC and Ingen data infrastructure</li> <li>Build the culture and processes that make governance a vision across both brands.</li> <li>Partnering with Creative, Social, Influencer, PR, CRM, Paid Media, Product Marketing, Commercial and Regional Marketing teams to ensure campaigns are fully integrated across every channel and market.</li> <li>Championing creative excellence throughout campaign development, ensuring consistency of messaging, visual identity and execution across all customer touchpoints globally.</li> <li>Using customer insights, market trends and campaign performance to continually optimise future campaigns and identify opportunities for innovation.</li> <li>Managing campaign budgets, timelines and resource planning to ensure efficient delivery.</li> <li>Building strong relationships with senior stakeholders across the business, influencing decision-making and aligning teams behind shared global campaign objectives.</li> <li>Leading, coaching and developing a high-performing Brand & Campaigns team, fostering collaboration, accountability and continuous development.</li> </ul> <h4>What We're Looking For:</h4> <ul> <li>Extensive experience in brand and integrated global campaign marketing, ideally within a global consumer, retail, lifestyle or wellness business.</li> <li>Proven experience developing and delivering large-scale, multi-channel global campaigns that deliver measurable brand and commercial impact.</li> <li>Strong understanding of brand strategy and how to translate it into engaging, customer-first global campaigns.</li> <li>Experience leading and developing high-performing marketing teams.</li> <li>Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence at all levels of the organisation.</li> <li>A commercially minded approach, balancing creativity with business performance.</li> <li>Strong organisational and project management skills, with experience managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.</li> <li>Confidence using consumer insights and campaign data to inform
